title: ReActWAM: Action-Consistent Caching for Efficient World-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) often generate future visual states alongside robot actions, introducing substantial computational overhead during inference. During closed-loop execution, consecutive inference cycles often predict similar action sequences, leading to redundant computation. However, reducing this redundancy requires distinguishing consistent actions from changes that demand fresh computation. To address these challenges, we propose ReActWAM, a training-free framework that combines action-intent-guided prefix skipping with inner-chunk prediction reuse. A coarse-to-fine assessment evaluates motion changes, visual consistency, and action prediction conflicts. For eligible chunks, we draw on first-step differences to adapt the cached latent and network features to the current condition, providing an estimate at a later denoising step that bypasses the redundant prefix. translated_title: ReActWAM：面向高效世界-动作模型的动作一致性缓存
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通常需要与机器人动作一起生成未来视觉状态，这在推理过程中引入了大量计算开销。在闭环执行期间，连续的推理周期往往预测相似的动作序列，导致冗余计算。然而，要减少这种冗余，需要区分一致的动作与需要重新计算的变化。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ReActWAM，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将动作意图引导的前缀跳过与块内预测重用相结合。该框架采用由粗到细的评估方式来衡量运动变化、视觉一致性和动作预测冲突。对于符合条件的块，我们利用第一步的差异将缓存的潜在特征和网络特征调整到当前条件下，在较后的去噪步骤提供估计值，从而绕过冗余的前缀。后续推理在重用稳定特征的同时对该估计值进行细化……
tldr: ReActWAM提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过动作意图引导的前缀跳过与块内预测重用来消除世界-动作模型闭环推理中的冗余计算，显著提升执行效率。
en_tdlr: ReActWAM is a training-free framework that eliminates redundant computation in world-action model inference through action-intent-guided prefix skipping and inner-chunk prediction reuse for efficient closed-loop execution.
